content:
I need to identify a book. Its DOI is 10.1353/book.24372 (Project MUSE / Johns Hopkins University Press). The book concerns a certain neurologist. I need to find:
1. The book title and author
2. The neurologist it concerns (likely Kurt Goldstein, associated with "endopsychic myths")
3. According to chapter 2 of the book, what author influenced this neurologist's belief in "endopsychic myths"? Give the last name only.

Please use websearch and webfetch tools to resolve the DOI, find the book, and research chapter 2's content. Try fetching https://doi.org/10.1353/book.24372, https://muse.jhu.edu/book/24372, https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1353/book.24372, and search for "Kurt Goldstein endopsychic myths" and "10.1353/book.24372". Report the book title, the neurologist, and the author's last name.
